notes.title: Character Guide | Blood Rose Corruption Build
notes.content:
In the Holy Copper Monastery, Isabella is a special being. She is not bound by the rules of the church, often disappearing for months, and not accepting tasks assigned to her by anyone other than the head of the church, Naga.
Some say she often shows up around the Golden Water Harbor, dressed as a maid and serving tea; others say they have seen her in the home of one of the generals of the Iron Scraps Kingdom, like a guest of honor; and there are also rumors that she wanders the mass graves along the Liberties, dressed in a black mourning dress, crying and laughing alone at an unmarked tombstone.
However, if there's something about Isabella that none of the congregation would deny, it would be that although her personality was extreme, she was so enchanting and unusual that anyone could not help but look at her more often, and had a group of passionate followers in the church.
There was a Lord of a big name even openly confessed to her marriage proposal. The congregation thought Isabella will agree.  To their surprise, however, the Lord died only one week later. 
Since then, no one call Isabella by her name. Instead, she's called "Blood Rose" by all. But Isabella herself does not care. Because right at the bottom of her heart, from the very beginning, there is only one person, and he's the exact reason why Isabella chose to join the Holy Copper Monastery.

[h2]Starting Position[/h2]
The unique card [b]"Pain Belief"[/b] swiftly stacks Magic Copper Power on minions, enhancing Worship, making this zero-cost card highly valuable. Magic Copper Power is the core buff for the corrosion flow's stacking damage.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/0d4345f2710015419a90f196001b2a593f3ab9cb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/262de388cf5e550134c04a691e691dacc2008e97.png[/img][/url]

The secret card [b]"Crystal of Shelter"[/b] mitigates the side effects of Magic Copper Power, inflicting substantial Corruption Damage on our minions. This card enables minions to withstand more Corruption Damage, facilitating output through Magic Copper Power and accumulating Corruption Damage. When equipped with the "Innate Rune," it is recommended to use it on core minions at the start to reduce early battle health consumption.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/ed5db35cf21b034d9f5ae389bc2f25e003f306a1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/6d003cb2ac1701face81cacb3e20131cff409ae0.png[/img][/url]

 
The initial talent [b]"Adaptation"[/b] decreases the health pressure from the side effects of Magic Copper Power, complementing "Crystal of Shelter" to minimize these effects.
 
[h2]Build Idea[/h2]
[h3]1.  Output[/h3]
Blue-Green Card Selection
When drawing cards, prioritize those containing Magic Copper Power and activation effects. Below are some recommended high-quality cards
[b]"Copper Whip"[/b] not only grants Magic Copper Power but also activation effects, with a multiplicative increase upon repeated use.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/7ded29d30697b294406b4a60a88ba2a3b1301c87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/2786236645f06dafeca455e0deaadc708bf49b19.png[/img][/url]

“Premature Evolution”，“Benediction of the End”，“Magic Copper Poison”，“Aggression”，all contribute to Magic Copper Power or its activation, boosting Corruption damage.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f8c9456f7da75eb618575ec7de40f619ca9229be.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/604b32ac342c525b0f890d15d4ec21b283bd9ede.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/70bccf76b941678718fc21bd9301cb552f552e35.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5d47676dca2e941bf24a59155038fab4294caa3e.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/19395e9c5589e1898fbd8bcc2e36a36785388bc8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/a0ac655d27706ceb7476b9882c7d0f25f3bc65a4.png[/img][/url]

Gold Card Selection
The essential core card is "Corruption Spread," storing corrosion inflicted on minions and enemies throughout the battle. This card enables concentrated bursts of damage, potentially reaching high instant kill damage of 1000 to 2000 in a single battle.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/32d09ca2f7c77082baa69809599877f9a980bf38.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/202a05c505d08b8f2a9be02b3d47269438086efb.png[/img][/url]
 
If "Corruption Spread" is unavailable, "Pollution" can be a key card, significantly enhancing the returns from Corruption Damage.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/ba4476fdf495f7de9704032dcf4c478fba75d869.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/91e82948a87baabffa958dd852131eef2997a79f.png[/img][/url]
 
Other viable gold cards include: Decay Strike, Transmutation Potion, Catalyst, and Accelerated Mutation.

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/6f13d8af641b426adea3497da40ff33a44c6ba4e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/4d1180a1fd5a6ec54c39d9fac4f4b87275733295.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/94a8a237eda6545bae7438b8f55947f885a1ec93.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/13ea9993e44d10f8ce5dfe7d4967f7c324061cca.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/42feab97255f0c5685db7adc6c7df3a6027bca57.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/769735f3dcd7584e6f413e1242295562d769d831.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/3ecb6e0e38c2a8955c145979c6a5ab6cf55615a6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/e95bd78197a80bc1460fcd7278fd315856795ba8.png[/img][/url]

[h3]2. Defence[/h3]
Puppeteer's defensive cards are relatively weak, relying on minions for protection. Prioritize the main body's survival, and consider the following decent defensive cards:

"Front Defense" provides Block and Taunt to the front row, shielding the main character from significant damage.
"Protect to the Death" grants Taunt to minions, effectively handling monsters targeting the main character.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/8edb83087dbb1ff2e7f1ebf8330e20a7134feb37.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/2218eabd89aeaa5ccab13b7185793f9ee1eb5a0d.png[/img][/url]
 
"Support" allows minions to absorb damage on behalf of the main character.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f542063d355ff7e8cc9fe664995d8b554ac81026.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/7f68fb256fea90397c0856d21987cdc3ee32d082.png[/img][/url]
 
For defensive gold cards, consider using "Revelation," which grants all Block when Worship is gained. When paired with Goblin Priest (Worship increase each turn), this ensures a fixed Block value for the entire team each turn.

  
[h3]3. Loop[/h3]
Prioritize cards that facilitate cycling, enabling the rapid return of "Corruption Spread" to the hand through zero-cost cycling cards, leading to multiple instances of massive damage output.
      

[h2]Followe Selection[/h2]
1、The top priority is "Scorched Centurion," a must-have minion that should be upgraded first. Its multi-hit attacks trigger Magic Copper Power multiple times, dealing area damage, and its passive ability "Slave Strike" adds "Magic Copper Whip" to the hand each turn, making it an excellent fit for the corrosion flow.
  
2、Next in line is "Gunner," whose intent each turn is Corruption Damage, aiding in stacking Corruption Damage for burst output. When Worship is high, Gunslinger's output per turn is substantial. (Gunner's passive ability is also potent)

3、Lastly, consider auxiliary minions such as "Goblin Priest," "Tainted Goblin," "Red Iris Spirit," and "Yellow Forest Fairy."
"Tainted Goblin" Taunts each turn, effectively shielding other minions and the main character from harm.
"Goblin Priest" grants the main character 1 cost each turn, crucial for Puppeteers without partner recruitment.
"Red Iris Spirit" adds 25 Block to the main character each turn, significantly enhancing survival.
"Yellow Forest Fairy" adds 15 Block to all each turn, bolstering the team's survival capabilities.

 
[h2]Card Strategy[/h2]
[h3]Stage One[/h3]
Early game, prioritize obtaining "Scorched Centurion." If unavailable, opt for auxiliary minions as mentioned earlier.
Consider acquiring summoning cards to bridge the early game without high-quality minions.

Replace attack cards with higher-quality ones. Defensive cards for Puppeteer can wait, as they can provide Magic Copper Power to minions.
The following are excellent replacements for basic attack cards: 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/d0a4617e4230fc04fb857ec62b8f4e2ec9ba83be.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/c690a196ebc64b82b41c4caa83cc424e5bedbd73.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/42fe3cdd1cc3726c1f39d28981301d00320309d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/098069dfcb2e43a10af27d819de68316fcf42403.png[/img][/url]
  
Runes should be prioritized with "Innate Rune" and "Transmute Rune." "Initiative Rune" should be used on "Crystal of Shelter" to obtain it at the beginning, allowing the core minion to start using Magic Copper Power for output. "Transmute Rune" should be used later on "Corruption Spread" to repeatedly play "Corruption Spread" inflicting high damage. 

"Magic Copper Power Rune" should be picked when encountered, and can be embedded on cards later to increase the stacking speed of Magic Copper Power.
 
[h3]Stage Two[/h3]
In the mid-game, optimize your deck by acquiring Magic Copper Power cards, activation cards, and card-drawing means that your faction requires.
Additionally, focus on upgrading your core minions as much as possible to make their intent cards and passive abilities stronger.
You can continue to fill in any missing cards at the shop.


[h3]Stage Three[/h3]
The overall strategy involves giving "Scorched Centurion" the Crystal of Shelter, then using cards that increase Magic Copper Power on "Scorched Centurion" before using "Temporary Magic Copper Whip" to deal massive Corruption Damage to monsters. While dealing damage, the damage of the card "Corruption Spread" also increases continuously due to the increase in Corruption Damage, ultimately leading to a burst of damage to end the battle.

[h2]Recommended Talents[/h2]
1.	Cursed Luck & Solidification & Alternate Energy
As Puppeteer is a profession without partners to increase energy, Curse Connection, Solidification, and Backup Energy provide crucial energy support.

2.	Loyal Shield, to enhance the survival ability of the main character.

3.	Fastidious Taste, for more stable acquisition of the required minions.

4.	Symbiosis, to boost the main character's survival ability.

5.	Indies Gift, directly promoting a minion by one star, enabling the faction to take shape earlier.

notes.title: Character Guide | Clyde & Brand Build
notes.content:
Clyde's parents are both mechanics from the Fireeyes. Due to their busy work schedules, he spent most of his childhood with his grandfather—a collector of antiques.

His grandfather's lifelong wish was to live long and never grow old, so he obsessively searched for the treasures left by the deities on the land of Mekka. Among his grandfather's collection, Clyde's favorite items were the gemstones. Influenced by his parents, Clyde often placed those brightly colored stones on instruments for testing.

When he was 17, Clyde went with his grandfather to a nameless town on the border of Greyrock. After much inquiry, they learned from a girl in the town that a stone was secretly revered in the town, but the townspeople had no intention of selling it...

Later, Clyde entered the Flame Blessing Academy to study. He was determined to fulfill his grandfather's wish—to achieve longevity and eternal life using Magic Copper. Thus, he began to purchase corpses privately to conduct research using Magic Copper. However, the Magic Copper intensified his desires, and his craving for the fresh bodies of humans ultimately turned him into a murderer, leading to his expulsion from the Flame Blessing Academy.

At this time, news arrived from his hometown that his grandfather was seriously ill. By his grandfather's sickbed, Clyde saw the gem from the small town. That night, an unexpected guest arrived at Clyde's home. She was the girl from years ago, but despite more than a decade passing, she remained as youthful as ever...

[h2]Starting Position[/h2]
[b]"Bounty"[/b] allows you to discard cards at a low cost, with powerful branding stacking abilities, making it the perfect exclusive card.
The initial secret skill card, [b]"Mutating Regeneration"[/b] enhances the damage power of followers & summons while providing healing abilities, making it an excellent support card.

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/03db93bec67d25c9c770f159fee73f5f5cafbd30.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/a8655e31ef973cf91cc2a5b587657ea87afc580f.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/cc0d51242e06ea52e367e5b016dae5830868ea46.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/01fafb0bd99d8dfa1a18e2962b3738f68e4d95e2.png[/img][/url]

The initial talent, "Deepen the pain," is the only special branding, enhancing damage effects. When combined with the character's exclusive follower, "Mechanical Hound," the double stacking of follower characteristics and branding damage increase provides substantial early-game output capabilities, with explosive damage in the later stages.

[h2]Build Idea[/h2]
[h3]1. Output/h3]
Prioritize cards that can stack "Brand", ensuring increased damage while allowing followers & summons to focus on the highest threat enemies, significantly reducing combat pressure.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/d0a4617e4230fc04fb857ec62b8f4e2ec9ba83be.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/c690a196ebc64b82b41c4caa83cc424e5bedbd73.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/046569e609266109712793a700b2c8cb60f719b8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/8604ab2c964d419b2c330a0d311db57a0441dc32.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/84ae4a6b684255244c87f7e8a08bdd5909347ae1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/47cec302870d8710028d33d765880e0345b6c498.png[/img][/url]

CORE CARD [b]"Psychic Scars" [/b]
Perfectly solves the mechanism where the number of branding layers halves each turn, ensuring continued stacking of accumulated damage buffs, making every hit more painful.
Combined with [b]"Betrayal"[/b] in battles against multiple enemies, it ensures uninterrupted output.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/ef0dad3698f163024d24d421e2a50e7e98d276ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/1452e5ea7f3d473aa327fdad6fb5b50f7b7aa17b.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/510f72698b41b466b39175e18540372b8e98095e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/e62c86912db111fbd732e4350fd25544c0645482.png[/img][/url]
   
[h3]2. Defense[/h3]
[b]"Front Defense" "Protect to the Death"[/b] and [b]"Support"[/b] are all high-quality defense cards
[b]"Taunt"[/b] can redirect attacks when the enemy targets the player, providing protection when combined with defensive followers, significantly reducing casualties
      
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/8edb83087dbb1ff2e7f1ebf8330e20a7134feb37.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/2218eabd89aeaa5ccab13b7185793f9ee1eb5a0d.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f542063d355ff7e8cc9fe664995d8b554ac81026.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/7f68fb256fea90397c0856d21987cdc3ee32d082.png[/img][/url]

[b]"Disruption"[/b] is particularly effective in battles against multiple enemies.
 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/396bf88b27771a5715f296cfe5982c403f469d83.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/01ff0ecd39440def9cbb608b91f3a3043ff17396.png[/img][/url]

[h3]3. Loop[/h3]
[b]"Trickery"[/b] and [b]"Glory of the Past"[/b] form an excellent pair, with each card offering impressive effects individually and synergizing to produce greater effects than the sum of their parts

[b]"Glowing Bronze"[/b] is the king of card draw cost-effectiveness, making it worth taking regardless of the build style.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/396bf88b27771a5715f296cfe5982c403f469d83.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/01ff0ecd39440def9cbb608b91f3a3043ff17396.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/93f98b26ee1c31ca62aa0d1bb3a9e38f128e49e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/14736a69839b398262a0dbd945a06b3fcf854bca.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/da300ac8aab61f7d38f95e9d9818ff129c7e7416.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/059443d204129f57390a3c647321841dd30394dd.png[/img][/url]
      
[h3]4. Recommended Followers[/h3]
[b]Malfunction[/b]
The only designated follower for branding stacking, providing a steady increase in branding layers each turn, serving as a small insurance when not drawing Brand cards
 
[b]Scorched Centurion[/b]
An excellent AOE damage dealer that also generates temporary cards to assist other followers in dealing damage.   

[h2]Card Strategy[/h2]
[h3]Stage One[/h3]
In the first stage, prioritize enhancing the ability to stack "brand" to ensure output.
Replace the initial attack with cards containing the "brand" property. If unavailable, prioritize high-value cards to transition and maintain strength.
If you encounter the "brand" rune in the shop, do not miss it.
    
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/42fe3cdd1cc3726c1f39d28981301d00320309d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/098069dfcb2e43a10af27d819de68316fcf42403.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/57ade1b5952470499e54bc12b775ec1a33497378.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/2d762b5a96291d7413c488c2507a5318f54daaa9.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5227a5d94bab8c1ffb8425a76a5625ec735095af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/11eef09f9a1a8af8eeae2132e32a69b2124fc302.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Stage Two[/h3]
In the second stage, strengthen defense and sustainability by replacing initial defense cards with high-quality defensive cards while supplementing card draw capabilities.
In addition to the three cards mentioned above, the following two are also excellent choices.
    
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/da300ac8aab61f7d38f95e9d9818ff129c7e7416.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/059443d204129f57390a3c647321841dd30394dd.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/42fe3cdd1cc3726c1f39d28981301d00320309d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/098069dfcb2e43a10af27d819de68316fcf42403.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Stage Three[/h3]
In the third stage, optimize the deck, streamline the card pool, embed key cards with runes, upgrade follower levels, and improve overall stability and strength.
The overall strategy is to rapidly stack branding layers, relying on increased damage for locking and swiftly eliminating high-threat enemies.

[h2]Talent Recommendations[/h2]
[h3]Highest Priority Talent[/h3]
For the early game, it is recommended to increase the probability of recruitment and refreshment to enhance the chances of finding key followers.

For the late game, [b]"Elite Troops"[/b] is recommended to effectively enhance follower output capabilities.
 
[h3]Other Recommended Talents[/h3]
Loyal Shield: At the end of a turn, the protagonist gains 3 block for each follower & summon on the field
Symbiosis: Front-row followers absorb 25% of the damage the player receives
Regeneration: At the start of each battle, all units gain 3 layers of regeneration
Uplifting: At the start of each battle, all units gain 2 strength
Power Strike: For the first two rounds of each battle, the friendly side gains piercing effect
Radical Change: When battling elites or bosses, all units gain 3 strength
Frost Armor: At the start of each battle, all units gain 5 layers of multi-layer armor
Shelter: Damage taken by the front row of our side is reduced to 75% of the original damage
Historian: At the start of the battle, if there are rune cards in your deck, all units gain 1 layer of armor

notes.title: Character Guide | Adeline & Summoner Build
notes.content:
Adeline isn't the youngest preacher in the Holy Copper Monastery, but she's definitely the most devout one, just as devout as when she competed to be the priestess of the old gods many years ago.
Adeline used to think that the old gods were benevolent and great, and so were their believers. Regardless of gender or social status, as long as one worships devoutly, one will hear the voice of the gods. But what happened later? Adeline herself couldn't remember. She only knew that it was the invisible gods who chose her…

[h2]Starting Position[/h2]
Exclusive Card [b]"Evil Minion"[/b] — can summon an attack dealing 9 damage and has a summons with the effect of "Death Whisper: deals 20 damage to all enemies." It can be used to block enemy attacks and inflict decent AOE damage.
Initial Skill Card [b]"Evil Spirit Shield"[/b] — a powerful low-cost blocking card that also deals a certain amount of damage when used on summons, suitable for both offense and defense.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/eecf2d28eff1cc016ec8eb730cf61af454f5e1a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/adc74376fb22cc64d636ce1604f53821757299ef.png[/img][/url] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/e5bcf70f02616894113139f7fda11787c57c06cb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/ebab55489b46140be5816719bf60fac972fe1297.png[/img][/url]

The initial talent [b]“Dead Souls”[/b] works well with the summoning strategy. With the powerful Death Whisper power of the Summons, it brings you unexpected benefits at each summon. 

[h2]Build Idea[/h2]
The summoning strategy can gain stable output ability by summoning powerful Followers, while also causing explosive damage by actively triggering the Death Whisper of summons. The creatures summoned can take turns to defend the main character, eliminating concerns about health issues. When necessary, sacrificing summons can lead to powerful effects.
It is important to flexibly use the "substitution" mechanism in summoning strategy — when the slots are full, summoning a new creature requires selecting one creature to "substitute," allowing the substituted creature to directly trigger the Death Whisper effect.

[h3]1. Output[/h3]
[b]"Evil Soldier"[/b] — with decent damage effects and can be summoned repeatedly, providing good early-game presence.
[b]"Evil Knight"[/b] — not only has excellent damage capability when on the field, but also deals at least 60 AOE damage upon death, making it one of the core cards in the summoning strategy. Although it requires sacrificing a creature, this cost is negligible for the summoning strategy.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5147c3dcfde0064d4595ce65985811f31f6854e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/019c07ac4d66f89e8137e0772e19c4676a46f155.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/a7526e80f75650930c00941f439a1aca007a534c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/4d3a4feb4b2be2b6baa99d9efa4535f34e543b50.png[/img][/url]

[h3]2. Defense[/h3]
[b]"Front Defense"[/b] — grants the front row creatures the "Taunt" effect, redirecting damage from the main character to the summons.
[b]"Scale of Destiny"[/b] — sacrifices a creature to gain a large amount of block, fitting well with the summoning strategy that can continuously summon creatures.
 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/d8cc75f960212a803e2e24ece31a94bf90ea0d59.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/0756da69705af5781ca7b2d0427962137e1b3dad.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/95bb34e5f67061b963e07cbc94eec2398ca9d92f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/1fd0edcb3ee92782ec0ae0c77f2675ca6e41793a.png[/img][/url]

[h3]3. Loop[/h3]
[b]"Extract"[/b] and [b]"Black Sheep’s Secret Order"[/b] — the ideas behind these two cards revolve around extracting cards at the cost of creature health, aligning well with the summoning strategy's characteristics, and importantly, they are both 0-cost cards!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5b7c719f651fb7257685d09f8f9d2f1fda9ee34c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/65df7a1733618e42ab3be9baa9b557d82af54825.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/34656a4b9d6da96ad8c8529daddbddad26495fb2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/a61e566f6c09c76f9d72d8b0852a32409ebcf766.png[/img][/url]

[h3]4. Follower Recommendation[/h3]
"Bamboo Fairy" — can gain permanent strength bonuses through sacrifice, making it the most suitable Follower for the summoning strategy. Upgraded, it can gain strength faster and even exceed hundreds of points in the late game!
 
"Gunner" — in the summoning strategy, most Followers cannot escape the fate of being sacrificed, so compared to on-field abilities, the trigger effects at the start of the turn are more important. Gunslinger can weaken the entire opposing team at the start of the turn, effectively mitigating the summoning strategy's defense shortcomings during setup.
 
[h2]Build Steps[/h2]
[h3]1. First Stage[/h3]
In the first layer, prioritize finding "Red Pilers" and "Evil Soldier," two summoning cards that can be used without sacrifice, and improve output capability by repeatedly triggering the Death Whisper effect of "Evil Minion." Additionally, obtain card draw cards like "Trickery" to prepare for subsequent repeated summons.
  
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/fb30ae55fced8f8e0bcc6bf3a0946e67c99feff0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/814c04c6dd6ed9b7e135c62eb5baf7754e4aefab.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/fda65cb9ae20086d68b46d584e0026f4e3395463.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/96cabc13166f3990d636abc6b1697a2e6af0375c.png[/img][/url]

On the Followers side, recruit "Bamboo Fairy" when encountered. If not available, recruit "Cave Spider" or "Tarama Exile," which can cause high damage in the early game.

[h3]2. Second Stage[/h3]
The second layer requires establishing an output core.
"Evil Scholar" and "Evil Knight" are important core components, to be acquired when encountered. If you can also get "Ritual" or "Irondust Evil Spirit," even better.
     
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/4392eca461e9802365bd3f41ecac360f34ac4f02.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/72de556a1105e3328e5f26a706bef13d701ef5d2.png[/img][/url]

[h3]3. Third Stage[/h3]
In the third layer, reinforce output capability based on the current output core — for example, if the output core is "Evil Knight," you can pick up "Fusion Summoning" to increase its health, or look for powerful defense cards to deal with the final boss, such as "Whispering Armor" or "Omen."
   
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5147c3dcfde0064d4595ce65985811f31f6854e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/019c07ac4d66f89e8137e0772e19c4676a46f155.png[/img][/url]


[h3]4. Rune Ideas[/h3]
As the Puppeteer profession lacks means of gaining resources, the cost reduction effect brought by the "Energy Rune" becomes particularly important and is the highest priority selection for runes.
The "Retain Rune" can be embedded in cards with the "Taunt" effect to ensure they can be used when needed.
Choosing the "Innate Rune" to ensure energy cards can be drawn in the first round is also a good choice.

[h2]Talent Recommendations[/h2]

[h3]1. Core Talent[/h3]
 
"Fear spread" -- The strongest talent for the summoning strategy, without a doubt. Every summon causes 20 points of AOE Corruption damage, making it an extremely powerful presence in the early, mid, and late game.

[h3]2. Recommended Talents[/h3]
"Loyal Shield" — a powerful defensive talent. The summoner's strong fielding ability makes this talent equivalent to gaining 9 blocks directly each round.
"Symbiosis" — gains the ability to transfer damage to front-row Followers.
"Alternate Energy" — effectively compensates for Puppeteer's lack of resources.

notes.title: Desires Flowing | Story Behind DLC
notes.content:
[h3][b]The Holy Copper Monastery[/b] is an emerging religious sect that worships the new god Indies.[/h3]
The notorious assassination organization Bloody Angels, which once had caused havoc in Mekaa, vanished overnight. However, when they were rediscovered hiding in the dark forest at the border between Riverpari and the Grayrock, the world found that those bloodthirsty killers had all transformed into devout religious believers.

They recognized the potential of magic copper, however sniffed at the rumbling machinery and the tide of steel. They believed that magic copper is not raw material for industry but a panacea for mankind.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/12e1b5a9113a00dec04e82285bd4c1c25d095e7b.png[/img]
 
[h3]The mysterious leader of the sect, [b]Naga[/b], never revealed her true face.[/h3]
Under her mask, she preached, spread the gospel, and cured diseases for the crowd. She rejected payment, asking only them to remember her words: "Miracles’ will follow… if you are willing to pay a price of faith."

Countless believers prostrated themselves under her tiara, yearning for even a word of her direct teachings. Although few were honored enough to enjoy such privilege. It's said that those most favored by her could not only hear the secret gospel…… but also receive her direct instruction of the mysterious “Puppetry”!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/1872aeb5d342bf88d452b32c11a5ee06379327d1.png[/img]
 
[h3]There were three of the most outstanding believers in the monastery. [/h3]
[b]The devout "Nun"[/b], who saved countless lives and was said to know every letter in the gospel;
[b]"Dark Doctor"[/b], the monastery’s surgeon, highly professional in human anatomy;
[b]"Blood Rose"[/b], charming yet weird, who would bring doom upon anyone who dared utter her real name.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/501f370558ae83619293b3f41d622dfe573d9b1a.png[/img]

[h3]Until one day, Naga mysteriously vanished.[/h3]
so was the monastery’s holy relic—a rare piece of magic copper enshrined in the main hall. As one of the outstanding believers, you’ll take on a journey to find Naga and the relic. You are not just a believer of Indies, but also a Puppeteer personally selected and trained by Naga herself. You can decipher the clues left behind by Naga… Moreover, you are hungry for truths about yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/2e0cc3399dafcc317fa821c5d4c6e152bd5cf20b.png[/img]

notes.title: Custom Difficulty is Live! – V1.1.0 Update Log
notes.content:
[h3]New Feature: “Taint” Custom Difficulty System
[/h3]
Dear Mekaa Adventurers,

Brace yourself for the V1.1.0 update with a custom difficulty system! We’ve [b]replaced the 20-level progression with this new system[/b]. It’s time to set your own rules! 

This new difficulty system has [b]24 options in total[/b]. Toggle on your desired options to add challenges to a run. Each option comes with a [b]“Taint” score[/b]. The higher sum it adds up to, the harder the game gets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/bf196beb4485f8712ca72883dc870414586325f1.png[/img]

To smooth you into the new system, your highest level beaten from the old level progression will be translated into your starting Taint cap. The Taint sum of your selected options could not exceed that cap. To raise the Taint cap, you need to finish a run with max Taint. We can’t wait to find out who’ll be the first to beat [i][b]the ultimate 99 Taint[/b][/i]!

[b]Highest level beaten → Starting Taint cap
[/b]20 → 50
19 → 48
18 → 46
17 → 44
16 → 42
15 → 40
14 → 37
13 → 36
12 → 34
11 → 32
10 → 30
9 → 25
8 → 25
7 → 25
6 → 20
5 → 20
4 → 20
3 → 15
2 → 15
1 → 10
0 → 5

We have also updated the difficulty mode selection (Easy / Normal / Advanced) and placed it on the chapter selection screen. [b]The custom difficulty system is unlocked at Advanced Mode[/b], and you’ll be able to choose between these modes when you start a new run. 

[h3]Updated Feature: Camp Rewards
[/h3]
To accommodate the new difficulty system, changes have been made to the camp rewards as well. The 16 camps remain the same, but the rewards have been optimized. 

We made the camp rewards more consistent, so rewards from the same camp will grant the same type of perks, for example card removal. When you enter the later stages, you will find in the camp options the same camp that you have selected at the previous stage.

* Details of the new rewards can be found in camp information.

[h3]Other updates:
[/h3][list]
[*] Removed monster skills with a 30-second time limit.
[*] Rohan’s talent “Life Blessing” now increases his temporary max HP by 15% instead of 20%.
[*] Perry’s talent “Blood Displacement” now increases his strength by 5 instead of 6.
[*] Ranger talent “Swordster” now grants 12 block instead of 8.
[*] Fire buff now takes effect after all block-related buff take effect.
[/list]
[h3]The game will be 20% off from May 23 to May 30. Get a copy for yourself or your strategy-loving friend!
[/h3]

notes.title: Indies' Lies Full Release now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/c6c5a822dd7f734cf18e56d05c501ab551f3cb63.png[/img]
[h3]Full Release Content Overview[/h3]
Dear Adventurers!

Finally! After 7 years in development and 1 year in Early Access We are moving to the Full Release!
Indies' Lies now officially offers the following new content：
✔️[i][b]Knights DLC with Rohan, Grace, and Perry to join the other 9 playable heroes[/b][/i]
✔️Reworked Rune System to enhance card modification depth
[b]-[/b] Now Runes can be attached to all cards, you can also attach up to 3 runes to one card.
[b]-[/b] Rework all 83 Rune Cards.
✔️[i][b]Reworked Class Cards for more complex synergy between buffs[/b][/i]
[b][i][u]Rework some Wizard Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We introduced the concept of "Even Psychic" to emphasize a more focused manipulation of Mekaa's witchcraft. We have also made builds based on Fire, Elements, View Cards, and Runes more powerful on a higher difficulty.
[b][i][u]Rework some Ranger Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added a "Terminate" feature to display rangers' dexterity as they finish their attacks. At the same time, as rangers roam the Mekaa land with many skills, we enhanced synergies between builds with different features (such as Poison, Stab, and Thorn).
[b][i][u]Rework some Mechanists Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added the concept of "Overload" to highlight that some old machinery is not fully developed (but can still be put to good use). We have also designed a new Auto experience with the new "Overload Scale", adding a "calculating" personality to the mechanists.

✔️[i][b]Reworked Talent System & enhanced many Talents[/b][/i]
Up to 120 talents have been optimized, with some new UI on the talent board and the maps. Some of the weaker talents have also been enhanced so that you have something to gain whenever you learn a new talent.

✔️[i][b]Added Special Battle Modes & Minigames[/b][/i]
You will encounter two "special battles" - Trial and Resentment on the map. We took inspiration from other games, such as a limited-time challenge with a huge flow of monsters in Hades, or Auto gameplay where the card sequence decides your results in Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game. These special battles will reward you with powerful artifacts that could boost you for the rest of the run!

✔️[i][b]Adjusted Difficulty according to feedback & Learning Curve[/b][/i]
With the above changes, the difficulty of the game has changed dramatically. It will be harder for beginners but easier to get better. We will continue to adjust the difficulty of the game based on your data - we hope that all players could have fun playing <Indies' Lies>!

[h3]DLC Knights will be free for 7 days after the Full Release![/h3]
To celebrate [b]Indies' Lies[/b] finally leaving Early Access, we decided to make the Knights DLC free for 7 days after the release. The DLC offers Rohan, Grace, and Perry as playable characters & allows you to dive into their stories.

[h3]Your feedback will make us very happy![/h3]
We appreciate your feedback! Share your thoughts here in the comments or leave a review on Steam. We welcome you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/GN4Dfq52AD]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/IndiesLies]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/IndiesLies]Facebook[/url].

V0.9.6 Update Log

Special Update!
To help new players ease into the game, we added a pop-up screen for players to choose a difficulty (easy, normal, hard) when they enter the game.
We also introduced a new scoring factor "Magic Copper Erosion" to reflect how tough the monsters are.
For Level 20, the monsters will become stronger (with higher Magic Copper Erosion level) when the player wins more games in a row. The leaderboard will also display Lv20 win streak information.
If you're more into the old version, you could always switch back in Steam Properties - Betas.

Others
Added card filter in the deck screen.
Players can now use ESC, SPACE or ENTER to close the card information screen called by right mouse click.
Optimized the battle background effects in The Other World.
Fixed some text errors.
Other bugfixes.

[h3]Another player has got over [b]6000 points[/b]! This player played as Janssen, the most popular Mechanist choice. Let’s learn from the best and find out how to master the Mechanist class.
[/h3]

“Auto” is exclusive to Mechanist cards. Many cards are designed for an Auto flow. This player’s build relies on two key cards: [i][b]Automation[/b][/i] and [i][b]Solid Rock[/b][/i].

[i][b]Automation[/b][/i]: Upgrade all Strikes and Defenses - Apply Auto and reduce cost to 0. Unlike for other classes, the starting Strike and Defense cards can prove very useful in a Mechanist build till the very end of a run, especially for Janssen. After you clear Janssen’s story mode, you unlock his exclusive talent [u][b]Universal Protection[/b][/u], which doubles his block for every 3 Defenses played. This combination allows you to build a massive Block value.

[i][b]Solid Rock[/b][/i]: Innate. Gain Stonewall effect (Block will not be removed at the start of turn). This is one of Janssen’s secret cards that you can choose at the start of the run.

Janssen is basically invincible with these two cards, as no boss could break through this defense. Then it's just a matter of time to kill the boss.

[h3]As for damage scaling, here are a few useful cards:
[/h3]
[i][b]Hardened Piston[/b][/i]. Hero gains 1 Overload whenever your team plays Auto cards. Stacking up Overload allows your attacks to deal substantially more damage (10% more damage per Overload stack). And you won’t even notice the side effect of Overload (Remove block equal to Overload stack at the end of the turn) thanks to Janssen’s copious amount of Block.

[i][b]Destructive Flow[/b][/i] + [i][b]Heat Damage Armor[/b][/i] (attached with [i][b]Energy Rune[/b][/i]). Destructive Flow could turn the Weary cards you get from Heat Damage Armor into Fierce. With the Retain bonus and Overload effect, Fierce could easily deal over 100 damage after a few turns.

[h3]Other Support Cards
[/h3][i][b]Perpetual Motion[/b][/i]: Draw 2 cards when energy is 0. This could help speed up your cycle.
[i][b]Heat Dump[/b][/i]: Deal 18 damage {cost+1} times to ALL enemies. Cost +1 when hero takes damage. This card would stay 0-cost because, well, Janssen is not taking any damage is he? Then you’re free to deal 18 damage at no cost!

In the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1638390/view/3208263159388830866]previous article[/url] we checked out the key components to the build that scored over 6,000 points. Today let’s take a look at some other great cards and talents for this build!

[h3]Talents[/h3]
[b][u]Infinite Arts[/u][/b]. (Rare Talent) For every 3 Skill cards you play in the same turn, deal 12 damage to ALL enemies.
[b][u]Hatred[/u][/b]. (Common Talent) Start each combat with 10 Thorn. This could help stack up Thorn while you’re still building up your deck.
[b][u]Tactical Instructor[/u][/b]. (Rare Talent) Choose a Skill card, Start each combat with this card in your hand. This effect could be used on Backflow or other key cards to get you ready right from the start.
[b][u]Rules of Engagement[/u][/b]. (Epic Talent) Each combat, the first Attack card you play will be played twice. With so few Attack cards in the deck, you can play Reverse Scales twice to double your damage if you have all your key cards in hand. 
[b][u]Alternate Energy[/u][/b]. (Epic Talent) When you have no Energy, gain 1 Energy (once each turn). Needless to say, no one would pass up on this talent!
[b][u]Chant of Creation[/u][/b]. (Rare Talent) Increase Hand Limit by 2. With this, the cards you draw will have a lesser chance of ending up in the discard pile when your hand is full.

[h3]Supporting Cards[/h3]
The supporting cards in this build are mainly used to draw cards.
[i][b]Ambition[/b][/i]: Discard all cards in your hand, then draw the same number of cards. Exhaust.
[i][b]Ready for Action[/b][/i]: Draw 3 cards. If the 3 cards drawn are all Attack cards, gain 2 energy.
[i][b]Raptor Attack[/b][/i]: If your last card played was a Skill card, draw 2 cards.
[i][b]Wilderness Walker[/b][/i]: Draw 2 cards. If a skill card is drawn, all gain 12 block.
[i][b]Eagle Eyes Refinement[/b][/i]: Gain 8 Block. If the last card played was a Skill card, draw 2 cards.
[i][b]Quick Load[/b][/i]: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. 
[i][b]Glide[/b][/i]: Draw 2 cards. Discard 2 cards.
[i][b]Surprise Attack[/b][/i]: Deal 10 damage. Draw 2 cards.

Recently, a rare high score of [h3][b]6,153 points[/b][/h3] appeared on the leaderboard. This is actually the first time I’ve seen a score over 6,000! And the player was using the Sigourney character, which is not a common choice. That certainly piqued my interest, and you must be wondering what deck he used to slay the bosses with full HP!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/5d591005ec21a59ec82f71a30ff1217cbe386656.png[/img]

The deck might look a bit confusing at first glance. It is mostly Skill cards with very few Attack cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/295422ecb95d2d7be37df2d9b4a6940ca1619108.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/16e609682bafbb74fb51aab6133406ed86c36da2.png[/img]

[h3]Key Cards
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f6401a4e70b9b16339005514c35a27fe6f5a73df.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Grudge[/b][/i] is selected as the Secret Card. Looks like this deck relies on frequent card draw to play Grudge repeatedly to increase Thorn stack. 
[i][b]Reverse Scales[/b][/i]. Once you've stacked up Thorn in a few turns, deal massive damage with Reverse Scales.

The choice of talents is vital for maximize the effects of this build:
[u][b]Raptor Counteract[/b][/u]. Gain 8 Thorn at the beginning of the combat, and 2 Thorn at the end of each turn thereafter.
[u][b]Wild Feedback[/b][/u]. For every card played, Sigourney gains 1 Thorn.
[u][b]Activate Hybrid[/b][/u]. Start each combat with Thorn equal to the number of deck cards.

Each of these three talents has its pros and cons.
Early in the game, Raptor Counteract is the strongest. Before you get the cards you need to cycle through your deck quickly, it takes about 3 turns to play Grudge once. During these 3 turns, Raptor Counteract could help you stack up Thorn. But as your deck thickens, the effect of Activate Hybrid will catch up with Raptor Counteract. If you accumulate enough 0-cost cards later in the game, Wild Feedback could get you plenty of Thorn in 2-3 turns.

With only Raptor Counteract and Activate Hybrid, it’s still difficult to kill the Boss in a short amount of time. It’s up to Wild Feedback to finish the job.

[i][b]2 Backflow with Transmute Rune[/b][/i]. This player has 2 Backflow, both with Transmute Rune attached. How did they get more than 1 Backflow or 1 Transmute Rune? – You might be wondering. There are 2 ways for you to make an exact copy of a card, one is a special event, the other is an epic talent Master Blacksmith, which allows you to copy a card in your deck (Rune effect included). The technique here would be to repeatedly play Backflow to draw the other Backflow, and just watch your Thorn go up and up!

Last week, an Evelyn player stood out among all the Keely players and made it to the top 3 of the leaderboard. Let’s check out their strategy for mechanists!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/825ca19a9174457a6ad6c7b50ddae95c2f1fba83.png[/img]

First let’s take a look at this player’s deck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/3a7efc9e0c24f4ebe7087753c1c3e10ec559ef8a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/496837ee1f701dfdb7681dc2ea76d7e888e4787d.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] [i][b]3 Phantom cards[/b][/i]. It seems that this player chose camp Flame Blessing Academy at the start of the game to gain 3 Phantom, at the cost of losing 50% max HP

[*] [i][b]Magic Recovery[/b][/i]. It puts 3 random Exhausted hero Skills into your hand. As long as you have a relatively “clean” deck, you could recover Phantom and Healing Shield every time
[*] [i][b]Pandora's Box[/b][/i]. So far this seems like a perfect defense, but let’s not forget about the cost. This player attached an [i][b]Energy Rune[/b][/i] to Magic Recovery but that’s far from enough. Ah wait, do you spot the 2 Pandora's Box in the deck?! Pandora’s Box completely ignores card costs and plays X cards on top of your draw pile in order until it's empty. Except for the fact that it can only target the front row, there doesn’t seem to be any drawback. There’s also [i][b]a key talent at play here - Experienced[/b][/i], which increase X-cost card effects by 2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f34dd3695d0df5f46c0954f83da1b7b96980dfcc.png[/img]
[*] [i][b]Perpetual Motion[/b][/i] with [i][b]Copy Rune[/b][/i] attached, which allows you to draw 4 cards and accelerates your card flow.

After looking at defense, how about offense on this deck?
[olist]
[*] [i][b]Automation[/b][/i]. Upgrade starting Attack and Defense cards, and reduce their costs to 0. It also applies Shock debuff to the enemies, and that Shock stack will be doubled at higher levels.
[*] [i][b]Resonance[/b][/i] is also a good choice for a Shock build. It could build up massive damage (the square of Shock stack). Although its cost increases per turn, but don’t forget that Pandora’s Box can back you up on that.
[*] [i][b]Cash Dash[/b][/i]. Resonance could deal high damage but the build-up takes a few turns. Cash Dash is a great solution. It costs you 50 gold to deal 50 damage, but it still works when you’re short on cash 😉
[/olist]

This is it for today’s content. Next, we’ll talk about other support cards and tips on Runes for this deck. Stay tuned! For more strategy discussion, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/t5bJB3jGky]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Strategy: Weekly Digest #1 (Part II)
notes.content:
Continuing on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1638390/view/3208261824655511987]previous article[/url], let's analyze the hidden logic behind this deck’s auxiliary cards and runes!
 
As you remember, the "Stab" card were used as the main source for dealing damage. Therefore, the whole deck was built around it, and, naturally, around enhancing its "Combo" effect (+1 damage this turn to all Combo cards for using a Combo card). 
 
[h3]Let us check other Combo cards first!
[/h3] 
[olist]
[*] [i][b]Falcon Drop[/b][/i] — adds 6 points to the Combo stack needed for the Stab cards. It also has Retain effect, allowing this card to stay in hand till the right time comes.
[*] [i][b]Hardened[/b][/i]. The card adds 5 points to Combo, while its Innate feature ensures that the card appears in hand at the start of each combat.
[*] [i][b]Catalyst[/b][/i] — apart from dealing instant damage, Stabs now apply additional delayed damage from Poison. After several rounds, the damage caused by Poison will be double of the Stabs.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/35cc21fc55d7e8f5b69472a7997e03c5c4d54d82.png[/img]

Above are cards that can directly increase damage dealt by Stab cards.
 
[h3]What about cards that could be boosted by playing Stab cards?
[/h3]"Stab" cards feature: 0 cost, large amount, damage increase through Combo effect. So, it affects cards that apply damage/effects based on the number of cards played this turn:
[olist]
[*] [i][b]Throat Lock[/b][/i] — each time a card is played, additional 8 points are added to the Poison stack.
[*] [i][b]Execution[/b][/i] — deal 10 points damage for every Attack card played this turn.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/33bb11aae124182cfd912018643ce9bb9aaab4df.png[/img]
 
They both have their timing tactics. Throat Lock suits best for the beginning of the turn when your hand is not yet formed, and gives a DoT boost to your strategy. Execution, on the other hand, shows better performance when it is played later. This card has more strict conditions than the first one, BUT it can use Strength bonus. Plus, it works well together with Keely’s Initial Talent Demon Hand — additional 4 damage points each time an enemy receives unblocked damage.
 
However, both cards have the same setback — they don’t have Retain effect, causing them to be somewhat “situational”.
 
The rest of the auxiliary cards in this deck use similar logic. 

[h3]Next, let's talk about the choice of Runes!
[/h3] 
[olist]
[*]  [i][b]Dispel Rune[/b][/i] — This player uses it at its fullest. We've heard some players complaining about certain enemy’s buffs being too powerful. Yet, they tend to ignore ways to dispel these buffs. So, here we are, and I will say it one more time: Dispel Rune deals no damage, BUT its functionality is AWESOME!
[*] [i][b]Transmute Rune[/b][/i] — it works best when attached to Backflow, which makes a huge deck more flexible. Transmute Rune allows you to take a card from the Exhaust pile, and Backflow — take one card from the Discard pile.
[*] [i][b]Healing Rune[/b][/i] — it is also a relatively powerful card. The game’s healing resources are very scarce, so this stable HP recovery card is just like a guarding angel.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/d28df6c02e7ed9d9976adc4647f0189022ab1837.png[/img]

If you have any questions, or would like to discuss more about strategies, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/t5bJB3jGky]Discord[/url] server!

notes.title: Strategy: Weekly Digest #1 (Part I)
notes.content:
[h3]We are starting a series of weekly posts with a goal to introduce real strategies for building powerful decks. Here, we will explain the ideas and core cards behind certain winners' builds.
[/h3]

Last week, a PRO player landed on top of the leaderboard with a score of [b]over 5000 (!) points[/b], beating the #2 with over 300 points. Let's take a peek at the deck they used!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/033dad4082fe84f5c816d67accec0baedd81c91a.png[/img]
 
The most shocking thing is, he did it all [b]without inviting Partners[/b]! 

The first card up his sleeve seems to be the "[b][i]Unholy Body[/i][/b]", which ensures decent HP recovery for a yet unformed deck.

Let's take a look at the damage dealing cards in this deck.

There are 2 "[i][b]Blade Dancers[/b][/i]" on the first page, each of which summons 3 "[i][b]Stab[/b][/i]" cards.
As it seems, this deck mainly uses "[i][b]Stab[/b][/i]" cards to deal damage.
To reinforce Stab cards, the player used the "[i][b]Splash[/b][/i]" card — it has the effect of making each Stab card be played twice!
"Stab" card doesn’t deal much damage by itself alone. However, thanks to the Combo effect of adding +1 to damage and the “[i][b]Butcher[/b][/i]” card’s Coward effect (for each attack on target get +10% to damage), Stab cards in no time becomes an overwhelming force as they have 0 cost and come in HUGE quantities! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/1f4c4f140db2e408d5355202a4371c7b173548a0.png[/img]

Let's talk about "Combo" effect mentioned earlier. After the 15th difficulty level, the starting [i][b]Strike[/b][/i] cards will be strengthened. Thus, “Combo” cards with gain +3 damage points! Unsightly before, these cards became the treasure now!
Was it always THIS EASY to deal over 100 damage points IN A SINGLE TURN, huh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/f9d8fa9c396e59463de6bf500cfdf3ed43038ddb.png[/img]
 
Now that we are satisfied the damage quota, how do we actually draw these cards?
1. As you can see, there are 2 "[i][b]Quick Load[/b][/i]" cards in the deck — the ultimate card-drawing tool! This card not only lets you draw cards till you have 5 cards in hand, but it also heals you 2 HP for each Skill card drawn!
2. "[i][b]Ripping Refinement[/b][/i]" — don't underestimate it due to being a “common” card, it provides effects not inferior to some “epic” cards! Along with dealing damage, it casts the Weak effect upon the enemy! This debuff decreases enemy damage on 25%, which often can save your run at critical moments.
3. "[i][b]Sharp Will[/b][/i]" allows you to draw 2 cards while dealing 7 points damage 2 times. This Kelly’s exclusive card deals quite enough damage and has great functionality. Probably, this is one of the reasons why many players love Keely.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/31381b8c049478737b4c8ffe95f940886067925f.png[/img]

That's all for today!
Next time we'll talk about auxiliary cards and Runes attachment strategies. For now, why don’t you try some of the ideas mentioned in this post? Who knows, maybe together with your own tactics today’s build will shine even brighter!

As huge fans of the roguelike deckbuilding genre, our team has spent almost five years working on “Indies’ Lies”, with the aim to bring a refreshing take on the genre that is both friendly for beginners and sophisticated for the experienced players. 

“Indies’ Lies” features:
